what: Verified the live Luna2 editor switches between opaque and alpha blend, and that the outgoing stereo stream contains a room mask.
why: The compositor is producing virtual foreground pixels and transparent room regions in both eyes. A physical Quest connection is still required to verify the room camera underlay.
details: The Capture Performers checkbox was visible and enabled. The headset view filtered 374 environment primitives. In a short local diagnostic all 14 encoded frames carried the protocol alpha flag. A decoded frame had 92.1% key-black pixels in the left eye and 90.6% in the right. This diagnostic used no headset camera feed. USB authorization and wearer confirmation are pending.
